question: Can the demo05 ptrace golden be made double-run stable by fixing how it is captured?
answer: No. Four capture defects were real (three prior, one found and fixed here), but a correct capture through 05-qemu-boot.py still yields 5 distinct qcow2 SHAs in ~18 runs. demo05 is DISQUALIFIED as a golden; dd bs=1 count=N reproduces at the same scale and should replace it.
binary_provenance: baked-in version string carries a -dirty marker; this binary reports clean
relaxations: none; only the real wall-clock prefix is stripped
mechanism: virtual-time drift: rcbs (PMU retired conditional branches) differs by 1 between runs, propagating into COMMIT times and clock_gettime results returned to the guest
not_established: which element of run 1's published pre-state reaches the guest (no targeted bisect)
PMU counter variability characterisation or its load dependence
whether the inode/address masks earn their keep across genuinely different host environments (untested; they removed 0 lines same-env)
the unpinned make build-hermit path was deliberately not exercised (it would move the primary checkout)
